description: This file defines an interface IProviderRuntime within the Orleans.Providers namespace. The interface provides methods and properties for provider callbacks, accessing grain factories, service providers, and binding extensions, primarily for provider management in Orleans.

classes.name: IProviderRuntime
classes.description: An interface enabling callbacks from providers to the provider-manager, providing access to runtime services like grain factory, service provider, and extension binding.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds an extension to an addressable object if not already done, returning the extension and its reference.
